//==
// # B-splines and NURBS

// A piecewise-polynomial B-spline curve in the plane
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B-spline). Knots must hold ControlPoints
// count + Degree + 1 values.
type BSplineCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
    Degree: Integer;
    Knots: KnotVector;
}
